Vertically it spans canvas 5-38 mm from the top, i.e. it begins within about 1-2 mm of the official mesh top edge (a z cut) and ends about 34 mm down the sheet. So the block is truncated by the mesh top, not closed above.

interpretation_UNCERTAIN: The block is about 60 mm wide, which is the text width of one column slot (pitch 76-78 mm minus a ~16 mm intercolumn; FAQ 4.5-6 cm columns). This fits a short last column of text (DOSSIER H1) at least as well as a narrow centred title (H2). The profile cannot tell text from title.

The block reaches the mesh top edge. The edge check (edge.json) finds sheet for only about +2 mm above it, and the scroll material ends +3 to +5 mm above. Any lines above the block are therefore at most about 2 mm of surviving sheet, or physically missing, consistent with the organizers statement.
